exposure: Electronic fetal heart monitoring during admission
outcome: Mode of childbirth (natural vaginal vs. cesarean delivery)
cohort: 320 postpartum women from four public and private hospitals in Mashhad, Iran.
finding: Early admission and performing electronic fetal heart monitoring during admission were associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Early admission (OR = 2.40; 95% CI = 1.93 - 2.97; P = 0.001) and performing electronic fetal heart monitoring during admission (OR = 2.47; 95% CI = 1.28 - 4.73; P = 0.006) were associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery.
